profile.summary: The Oakland Fund for Children and Youth (OFCY) is a City of Oakland program created in 1996 by a vote of city residents. It provides funding to nonprofit organizations and agencies that offer direct services to children, youth and families in Oakland, including education, career readiness, health and community programs.
